# Kokoro TTS worker environment (.venv-kokoro, Python 3.11 - the kokoro/misaki packages need Python < 3.13).

# The model (hexgrad/Kokoro-82M, ~330 MB, Apache-2.0) and spaCy's small English model download on first start.
